cards.b: A mark made by a moving point; shows edges, direction and movement.
How light or dark something is.
A flat, two-dimensional enclosed area. Can be geometric or organic.
A three-dimensional object, real or implied in a drawing by tone and perspective.
Actual can be felt (collage, thick paint). Visual is drawn or painted to look like a texture.
Parallel lines (and layers of crossing lines) used to build tone; closer together = darker.
Strong contrast of light and dark, used by Rembrandt and Caravaggio for drama and solid form.
A rubbing taken with pencil or crayon over a textured surface.
Thick paint applied so brushstrokes or palette-knife marks stand out.
The space around and between the main objects. Drawing it helps accuracy.
Warm: reds, oranges, yellows (advance). Cool: blues, greens, purples (recede).
The place the eye goes first, made by strongest contrast, colour or size.
Highlight, mid-tone, core shadow, reflected light, and a cast shadow on the surface.
Place key features on the thirds lines of the picture rather than dead centre.
How pure or strong a colour is.

short.q: Explain the difference between shape and form.
short.model: Shape is flat and two-dimensional; form is three-dimensional or looks it through tone and perspective.

short.q: Describe two techniques for creating tone with a pen.
short.model: Hatching with closely spaced parallel lines, cross-hatching with crossing layers, or stippling dots; denser marks make darker tone.

short.q: How can an artist use line to show emotion? Give two ways.
short.model: Use heavy, bold, fast lines for energy or anger, and light, broken, wobbly lines for fragility or nervousness.

short.q: What is a focal point and how do you make one?
short.model: The place the eye goes first. Make it with the strongest contrast of tone or colour, the largest shape or placement on a thirds line.

short.q: Name one artist and describe how they use a formal element.
short.model: Egon Schiele used a confident, expressive contour line in figure drawings; or Matisse used flat bold colour shapes.
